مَحْشُومٌ Angered. (TA.) [But it is implied in the S that it signifies Confounded and stupified by shame; or ashamed and confounded or stupified, and remaining speechless and motionless.] A poet says, “لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّ قُرْصَ أَبِى خُبَيْبٍ
بَطِىْءُ النُّضْجِ مَحْشُومُ الأَكِيلِ
” [By thy life, verily the round cake of bread of Aboo-Khubeyb is slow in becoming thoroughly baked: the eater is angered, or confounded and stupified by shame, &c.]. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
